title: Python Developer
description: A roadmap for becoming a professional Python developer across scripting, web APIs, databases, testing, automation, packaging, and deployment.

tree.name: Python Foundations
tree.description: Learn Python syntax, data structures, functions, modules, files, exceptions, virtual environments, and clean code habits.

resources.title: Python Tutorial for Beginners in Hindi (CodeWithHarry)

children.name: Core Language
children.description: Use lists, dicts, comprehensions, classes, iterators, decorators, context managers, and type hints.

children.name: Tooling and Environments
children.description: Manage venvs, pip, pyproject.toml, formatting, linting, debugging, logging, and project layouts.

tree.name: Web APIs and Databases
tree.description: Build backend services with FastAPI or Django, persist data, validate requests, and document APIs.

children.name: FastAPI or Django
children.description: Learn routing, request validation, ORM patterns, auth, background tasks, settings, and API docs.

children.name: SQL and ORM
children.description: Use PostgreSQL, migrations, indexes, transactions, SQLAlchemy/Django ORM, and connection pooling.

children.name: Practice: CLI Automation Tool
children.description: Write a tested Python CLI that reads files/API data, logs actions, handles errors, and produces a report.

tree.name: Testing, Automation, and Reliability
tree.description: Write reliable code with automated tests, scripts, background jobs, observability, and deployment discipline.

children.name: Testing and CI
children.description: Use pytest, fixtures, mocks, coverage, type checking, GitHub Actions, and contract tests.

children.name: Automation and Background Jobs
children.description: Build CLIs, schedulers, queues, web scrapers, file processors, and admin scripts with logging and retries.

tree.name: Deployment and Portfolio
tree.description: Package, containerize, deploy, monitor, and document a production-style Python application.

children.name: Deployment Patterns
children.description: Deploy with Docker, environment variables, migrations, health checks, logs, metrics, and rollback plans.

children.name: Project: Operations API
children.description: Build a FastAPI service with PostgreSQL, auth, tests, CI, Docker, background jobs, monitoring, and API docs.
